<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="size = size === 'big' ? 'small' : 'big'"
		>切换密度</AsamButton
	>
	<AsamConfigProvider :size="size" :z-index="0">
		<template #default="scope">
			<output v-bind="domDataAttrs('data-state', 'z-index')">{{
				scope.config?.zIndex
			}}</output>
			<AsamText v-bind="domDataAttrs('data-density', 'inherited')">继承密度</AsamText>
			<AsamText size="large" v-bind="domDataAttrs('data-density', 'explicit')">
				显式密度
			</AsamText>
		</template>
	</AsamConfigProvider>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamConfigProviderBoundariesDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider, AsamText } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('big');

type DemoDataAttributes = Record<`data-${string}`, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;
const domDataAttrs = (
	name: `data-${string}`,
	value: string | number | boolean | null | undefined = ''
): Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'class'> & DemoDataAttributes => ({
	class: 'ui032-data-marker',
	[name]: value
});
</script>

<template>
	<label
		>展开方向
		<AsamSelect :model-value="direction" @change="changeDirection">
			<AsamOption value="ltr" :label="'从左展开'">从左展开</AsamOption>
			<AsamOption value="rtl" :label="'从右展开'">从右展开</AsamOption>
			<AsamOption value="ttb" :label="'从上展开'">从上展开</AsamOption>
			<AsamOption value="btt" :label="'从下展开'">从下展开</AsamOption>
		</AsamSelect></label
	>

	<AsamDrawer v-model="drawer" :direction="direction" resizable> 这是抽屉内容。 </AsamDrawer>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamDrawer,
	type AsamDrawerProps as DrawerProps
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

const direction = ref<DrawerProps['direction']>();
const drawer = ref(false);

const changeDirection = (value: unknown) => {
	if (value === 'ltr' || value === 'rtl' || value === 'ttb' || value === 'btt') {
		direction.value = value;
		drawer.value = true;
	}
};
</script>

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFilterDemo' });
import { AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
	tag: string;
}

const tableRef = ref<AsamTableExpose<User>>();

const resetDateFilter = () => {

		<AsamTableColumn prop="amount2" label="费用 2 ($)" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="amount3" label="费用 3 ($)" />
	</AsamTable>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageSummaryDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h } from 'vue';

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Product {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SummaryMethodProps<T extends Product = Product> {
	columns: AsamTableColumnCtx<T>[];
	data: T[];
}

const getSummaries = (param: SummaryMethodProps) => {
	const { columns, data } = param;
	const sums: (string | VNode)[] = [];
	columns.forEach((column, index) => {
		if (index === 0) {
			sums[index] = h('div', { style: { textDecoration: 'underline' } }, ['总费用']);
			return;
		}
		const values = data.map((item) => Number(Reflect.get(item, column.property)));
		if (!values.every((value) => Number.isNaN(value))) {
			sums[index] = `$ ${values.reduce((prev, curr) => {
				const value = Number(curr);
				if (!Number.isNaN(value)) {
					return prev + curr;
				} else {
					return prev;
				}
			}, 0)}`;
		} else {
			sums[index] = 'N/A';
		}
	});

	return sums;
};

const tableData: Product[] = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '234',
		amount2: '3.2',
		amount3: 10
	},
	{
		id: '12987123',

		amount1: '165',

		amount3: 12
	},
	{
		id: '12987124',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '324',
		amount2: '1.9',
		amount3: 9
	},
	{
		id: '12987125',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '621',
		amount2: '2.2',
		amount3: 17
	},
	{
		id: '12987126',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '539',
		amount2: '4.1',
		amount3: 15
	}
];
</script>

		:actions="withActions ? actions : []"
		@action="action = $event"
	/>
	<output v-bind="domDataAttrs('data-task-action')">{{ action }}</output>

import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTaskCard } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTaskCardAction, AsamTaskCardStatus } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTaskCardBoundariesDemo' });
const step = ref(0);
const withActions = ref(true);
const states: AsamTaskCardStatus[] = ['pending', 'inProgress', 'completed'];
const actions: AsamTaskCardAction[] = [{ key: 'confirm', label: '确认任务', variant: 'primary' }];
const action = ref('');

type DemoDataAttributes = Record<`data-${string}`, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;
const domDataAttrs = (
	name: `data-${string}`,
	value: string | number | boolean | null | undefined = ''
): Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'class'> & DemoDataAttributes => ({
	class: 'ui032-data-marker',
	[name]: value
});
</script>

-->
<template>
	<AsamTabs
		:model-value="editableTabsValue"
		type="card"
		editable
		class="demo-tabs"
		@update:model-value="
			(value) => {
				if (typeof value === 'string') editableTabsValue = value;
			}
		"
		@edit="handleTabsEdit"
	>
		<AsamTabPane
			v-for="item in editableTabs"
			:key="item.name"
			:label="item.title"
			:name="item.name"
		>
			{{ item.content }}
		</AsamTabPane>
	</AsamTabs>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTabsCapDynamicTabsDemo' });
import { AsamTabs, AsamTabPane } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTabsTabPaneName } from '@asam-ui/ui';

let tabIndex = 2;
const editableTabsValue = ref('2');
const editableTabs = ref([
	{
		title: '标签页一',
		name: '1',
		content: 'Tab 1 content'
	},
	{
		title: '标签页二',
		name: '2',
		content: '标签页二的内容'
	}
]);

const handleTabsEdit = (targetName: AsamTabsTabPaneName | undefined, action: 'remove' | 'add') => {
	if (action === 'add') {
		const newTabName = `${++tabIndex}`;
		editableTabs.value.push({
			title: '新标签页',
			name: newTabName,
			content: '新标签页内容'
		});
		editableTabsValue.value = newTabName;
	} else if (action === 'remove') {
		const tabs = editableTabs.value;
		let activeName = editableTabsValue.value;
		if (activeName === targetName) {
			tabs.forEach((tab, index) => {
				if (tab.name === targetName) {
					const nextTab = tabs[index + 1] || tabs[index - 1];
					if (nextTab) {
						activeName = nextTab.name;
					}
				}
			});
		}

		editableTabsValue.value = activeName;
		editableTabs.value = tabs.filter((tab) => tab.name !== targetName);
	}
};
</script>

<style>
/* stylelint-disable selector-class-pattern -- Base-component BEM selectors are required for this demonstration. */

.demo-tabs > .el-tabs__content {
	padding: 32px;
	color: #6b778c;
	font-size: 32px;
	font-weight: 600;
}

/* stylelint-enable selector-class-pattern */
</style>

		const newTabName = `${++tabIndex}`;
		editableTabs.value.push({

			name: newTabName,
			content: '新标签页内容'
		});
		editableTabsValue.value = newTabName;
	} else if (action === 'remove') {
		const tabs = editableTabs.value;
		let activeName = editableTabsValue.value;
		if (activeName === targetName) {
			tabs.forEach((tab, index) => {

					const nextTab = tabs[index + 1] || tabs[index - 1];
					if (nextTab) {
						activeName = nextTab.name;

				}
			});

		editableTabsValue.value = activeName;
		editableTabs.value = tabs.filter((tab) => tab.name !== targetName);

};

<template>
	<section>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="chinese">中文本地化</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamConfigProvider :locale="chinese ? zhCn : en">
			<AsamCalendar
				:key="chinese ? 'zh-cn' : 'en'"
				v-model="value"
				v-bind="configuration"
				@update:model-value="changes++"
			/>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<output>模型 {{ value }}；模型更新次数 {{ changes }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref, watch, onUnmounted } from 'vue';
import { createCalendarDateLocaleSession } from './date-locale-session.js';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamCalendar, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCalendarProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { zhCn, en } from './locale.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamCalendarAdvancedContractExample' });
const chinese = ref(true);
// Fixed Calendar reads the global week start once when its table is created.
const dateLocaleSession = createCalendarDateLocaleSession();
watch(chinese, (enabled) => dateLocaleSession.select(enabled ? 'zh-cn' : 'en'), {
	immediate: true,
	flush: 'sync'
});
onUnmounted(dateLocaleSession.release);
const changes = ref(0);
const value = ref<Date>(new Date(2026, 9, 4));
const configuration: AsamCalendarProps = {
	controllerType: 'select',
	formatter: (value, type) => value + (type === 'year' ? '年' : '月')
};
</script>

import dayjs from 'dayjs';
import dateLocale from 'dayjs/locale/zh-cn.js';

// Register date locale on the same public Day.js instance used by the components.
// The third argument preserves the application default; the provider selects per component.
dayjs.locale(dateLocale, undefined, true);

/** Application-authored dictionary, supplied through the public provider. */
export const zhCn = {
	name: 'zh-cn',

<template>
	<section>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="chinese">中文本地化</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamConfigProvider :locale="chinese ? zhCn : en">
			<AsamCalendar
				:key="chinese ? 'zh-cn' : 'en'"
				v-model="value"
				v-bind="configuration"
				@update:model-value="changes++"
			/>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<output>模型 {{ value }}；模型更新次数 {{ changes }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onUnmounted } from 'vue';
import { createCalendarDateLocaleSession } from './date-locale-session.js';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamCalendar, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { zhCn, en } from './locale.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamCalendarAdvancedContractExample' });
const chinese = ref(true);
// Fixed Calendar reads the global week start once when its table is created.
const dateLocaleSession = createCalendarDateLocaleSession();
watch(chinese, (enabled) => dateLocaleSession.select(enabled ? 'zh-cn' : 'en'), {
	immediate: true,
	flush: 'sync'
});
onUnmounted(dateLocaleSession.release);
const changes = ref(0);
const value = ref(new Date(2026, 9, 4));
const configuration = {
	controllerType: 'select',
	formatter: (value, type) => value + (type === 'year' ? '年' : '月')
};
</script>

	AsamRadioGroup,

	const marginMap = {

		marginTop: marginMap[size.value] || marginMap.default
	};
});

<template>
	<AsamInput
		v-if="editing"
		ref="input"
		:model-value="value"
		:aria-label="label"
		@input="change"
		@blur="emit('finish')"
		@keydown.enter="emit('finish')"
		@keydown.esc="emit('cancel')"
	/>
	<AsamButton type="primary" v-else native-type="button" @click="emit('start')">{{
		value
	}}</AsamButton>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamInput, type AsamInputExpose, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { nextTick, ref, watch } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps<{ value: string; label: string; editing: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ change: [value: string]; start: []; finish: []; cancel: [] }>();
const input = ref<AsamInputExpose>();
watch(
	() => props.editing,
	async (value) => {
		if (value) {
			await nextTick();
			input.value?.focus();
		}
	}
);
function change(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'string') emit('change', value);
}
</script>

		</AsamSelect></label
	>
	<AsamTableV2
		:columns="columns"
		:data="rows"
		:width="640"
		:height="260"
		:row-height="44"
		:cell-props="cellProps"
		row-key="id"
	>
		<template #row="{ cells, rowIndex }">
			<RowRenderer :cells="cells" :row-index="rowIndex" :merge="merge" :mode="mode" />
		</template>
	</AsamTableV2>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2SpansDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns, AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import RowRenderer from './RowRenderer.vue';
const merge = ref(true);
const mode = ref<'row' | 'column' | 'both'>('both');
const cellProps: AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }) => ({
	'data-merged':
		merge.value && rowIndex % 2 === 0 && columnIndex === 0
			? mode.value === 'both'
				? '2x2'
				: mode.value === 'row'
					? '2x1'
					: '1x2'
			: undefined
});
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = ['name', 'group', 'count', 'note'].map(
	(key, index) => ({
		key,
		dataKey: key,
		title: ['姓名', '分组', '数量', '备注'][index] ?? key,
		width: 140
	})
);
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `合并记录 ${id + 1}`,
	group: `分组 ${Math.floor(id / 2)}`,
	count: id,
	note: '独立未合并列'
}));
</script>

files.source:
<template><RenderCells /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { cloneVNode } from 'vue';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps<{
	cells: VNode[];
	rowIndex: number;
	merge: boolean;
	mode: 'row' | 'column' | 'both';
}>();
const RenderCells = () => {
	const cells = [...props.cells];
	if (!props.merge) return cells;
	const mergeRow = props.mode !== 'column';
	const mergeColumn = props.mode !== 'row';
	if (!mergeRow || props.rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], {
			style: {
				width: mergeColumn ? '280px' : '140px',
				height: mergeRow ? '87px' : '44px',
				alignSelf: 'flex-start',
				zIndex: 1,
				background: 'var(--asam-color-surface)',
				border: '1px solid var(--asam-color-border)'
			},
			'data-merged': '2x2'
		});
		if (mergeColumn) cells.splice(1, 1);
	} else {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
		if (mergeColumn) cells[1] = cloneVNode(cells[1], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
	}
	return cells;
};
</script>

import type { AsamTreeLoadFunction } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const props = {
	label: '姓名',

};

				]);
			} else {

			}
		}, 3000);
	}
};

<template>
	<AsamButton
		v-asam-loading.fullscreen.lock="fullscreenLoading"
		type="primary"
		@click="openFullScreen1"
	>
		指令方式
	</AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="openFullScreen2"> 服务方式 </AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamLoading, type AsamLoadingInstance, vAsamLoading } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

import { ref } from 'vue';

const fullscreenLoading = ref(false);
const openFullScreen1 = () => {
	fullscreenLoading.value = true;
	setTimeout(() => {
		fullscreenLoading.value = false;
	}, 2000);
};

const openFullScreen2 = () => {
	const loading = trackAsamLoading(
		AsamLoading.service({
			lock: true,
			text: 'Loading',
			background: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)'
		})
	);
	setTimeout(() => {
		loading.close();
	}, 2000);
};

const ownedAsamLoading = new Set<AsamLoadingInstance>();
let mountedAsamLoading = true;
const trackAsamLoading = (handle: AsamLoadingInstance) => {
	if (mountedAsamLoading) ownedAsamLoading.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamLoading = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamLoading) handle.close();
	ownedAsamLoading.clear();
});
</script>

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm(
		({ confirm, cancel, close }) => {
			return h('div', [
				h('p', { style: 'margin-bottom: 8px' }, '自定义按钮使用消息框操作处理器'),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'primary',

							confirm();
						}
					},
					() => '完成（resolve）'
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'danger',
						onClick: () => {
							cancel();
						}
					},
					() => '拒绝（reject）'
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						onClick: () => {
							close();
						}
					},
					() => '关闭（close）'
				)
			]);

		{
			title: '消息',

			distinguishCancelAndClose: true

					type: 'success',
					message: `resolved: ${action}`

};

	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

	<AsamButton plain type="danger" @click="open('error')"> 错误 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton plain type="info" @click="open('info')"> 信息 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="primary" plain @click="openCustomColor"> 自定义颜色 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="primary" plain @click="openWithoutPause"> 悬停时不暂停 </AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamNotification,
	type AsamNotificationHandle,
	type AsamNotificationType
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

function open(type: AsamNotificationType) {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: `${type || 'Default'} progress`,
			message: '鼠标悬停时暂停计时和进度条。',
			type,
			duration: 6000,
			progress: true
		})
	);
}

function openWithoutPause() {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: '悬停时不暂停',
			message: '鼠标悬停时计时和进度条继续运行。',
			duration: 6000,
			progress: true,
			pauseOnHover: false
		})
	);
}

function openCustomColor() {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: '自定义颜色',
			message: '自定义进度条颜色覆盖默认颜色。',
			duration: 6000,
			progress: {
				color: [
					{ color: '#f56c6c', percentage: 20 },
					{ color: '#e6a23c', percentage: 40 },
					{ color: '#5cb87a', percentage: 60 },
					{ color: '#1989fa', percentage: 80 },
					{ color: '#6f7ad3', percentage: 100 }
				]
			}
		})
	);
}

const ownedAsamNotification = new Set<AsamNotificationHandle>();
let mountedAsamNotification = true;
const trackAsamNotification = (handle: AsamNotificationHandle) => {
	if (mountedAsamNotification) ownedAsamNotification.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamNotification = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamNotification) handle.close();
	ownedAsamNotification.clear();
});
</script>

<template>
	<AsamTooltip
		:visible="visible"
		content="底部居中"
		placement="bottom"
		effect="light"
		trigger="click"
		virtual-triggering
		:virtual-ref="triggerRef"
	/>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="visible = !visible">切换文字提示</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamTooltip } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';

const visible = ref(false);
const position = ref(DOMRect.fromRect({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 }));

const triggerRef = ref({
	getBoundingClientRect: () => position.value
});

const mousemoveHandler = ({ clientX, clientY }: MouseEvent) => {
	position.value = DOMRect.fromRect({
		x: clientX,
		y: clientY
	});
};

onMounted(() => {
	document.addEventListener('mousemove', mousemoveHandler);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
	document.removeEventListener('mousemove', mousemoveHandler);
});
</script>

const type = ref<AsamDatePickerPanelProps['type']>('quarter');
const value = ref<AsamDatePickerPanelValue>(null);

const border = ref(true);
const panelChanges = ref(0);
const recordPanel = () => {
	panelChanges.value++;
};
watch(type, () => {
	value.value = null;
});
</script>

const disabledSeconds = (hour: number, minute: number) =>
	hour === limit.value && minute === 30 ? [0, 1, 2] : [];

};

watch(scenario, () => {
	value.value = null;
});

import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createDemoState, createDemoProvider } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectNativePresentationDemo' });
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();

	if (!host.value) return;
	const state = createDemoState();

	app.provide('selection-presentation', state);
	provideAsamData(app, createDemoProvider(state), { scope: 'native-presentation' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());

];

});

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteCascaderDemoLocalErrorExample' });
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createTransport } from './transport.js';
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const transport = createTransport();
	app = createApp(Child, { transport });
	provideAsamData(app, transport.provider, { scope: 'AsamRemoteCascader-local-error' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
